name: S. K. Offset Limited
about: S. K. Offset Limited provides printing and packaging solutions. The company offers various solutions, including printing services, such as offset printing for books, pamphlets, mono cartons, labels, and master cartons; packaging solutions, including mono-cartons, rigid boxes, folding cartons, laminated packaging boxes, and corrugated cartons; and labelling solutions; such as labels, stickers, barcodes, and posters. It serves FMCG, food and beverages, pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, corporate services, healthcare, education, and industrial packaging sectors. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Meerut, India.
